conflicts.note: Vietnam played spring-to-autumn until 2023; since 2023-24 the season is autumn/spring, so the current one is 2026-27.

notes: 14 clubs, 26 rounds, single table, no split and no championship play-off. Bottom two are relegated directly to V.League 2 (2025-26: PVF-CAND 13th and Becamex Ho Chi Minh City 14th, both of whom appear in the 2026-27 second-tier list). V.League 2 is itself 14 clubs / 26 rounds with two up and two down, but it is not in our rows, so VIE1 carries closed_down=true: two clubs leave the modelled pyramid each season and two enter from outside it. Reserve sides can appear in the second tier (Hanoi FC B in 2026-27), so its promotion places are not always the top two clubs.
